detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Suggested fall target for assistantship consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Department accepts rolling applications but strongly recommends its January target. No year stated.

english.toefl: 82 or 4.5; TA minimum 98 or 6, as published
english.note: Teaching assistants need IELTS7. A degree from an English-speaking institution can exempt the test; academic units may still request scores. Current central scores supersede old paper-TOEFL numbers on the department application page.

applicationFee.note: IRT/McNair scholars, current/former US Armed Forces members/dependents and University of Maine System alumni qualify under listed categories. Confirm international eligibility for an applicable category. Program-specific temporary waivers, when offered, are announced to applicants who started an application.

documents: Transcripts (unofficial accepted for review; official after a decision)
requirements.note: Biological-science bachelor’s preparation expected; related science/math coursework assessed. Faculty advisor commitment required before admission; contact prospective advisors before applying. International applicants are urged to apply at least six months before arrival.

funding.note: Department typically supports graduate students through teaching/research assistantships for 4–5 PhD years and automatically considers applicants unless they indicate no need. Teaching assistantships are nine-month appointments with tuition waiver up to nine credits per semester. Funding package depends on advisor and appointment; no unconditional all-admitted guarantee retained.
